lines.zh: 冠里的空气一响，我就知道该走了。
lines.en: The air in my crest hums, and I know it's time to move.

lines.zh: 四蹄踏过沙地，留下一串浅坑。
lines.en: Four hooves cross the sand, leaving a string of shallow pits.

lines.zh: 我低头走，鼻子离草很近。
lines.en: I walk with my head low, nose close to the grass.

lines.zh: 前面那片平原，是我们的老路。
lines.en: The plain ahead is our old road.

lines.zh: 长冠向后倾，走路时像扛着号角。
lines.en: My long crest tilts back like a horn I carry.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面的尾巴，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow the tail ahead and never miss a step.

lines.zh: 后腿有劲，前腿短，走得有点摇。
lines.en: Strong hind legs, stubby front ones — I sway a bit.

lines.zh: 草丛里沙沙响，我换了个方向。
lines.en: Something rustles in the grass and I change course.

lines.zh: 风从侧面吹，我怕冠被吹歪。
lines.en: Wind from the side; I fear it will bend my crest.

lines.zh: 沙质地面走起来软，很舒服。
lines.en: Sandy ground is soft underfoot — pleasant.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边嚼，嘴里没停过。
lines.en: I chew as I walk; my mouth never rests.

lines.zh: 河水声在左边，我们朝那边去。
lines.en: Water sounds to the left; we head that way.

lines.zh: 队列散了，我回头找同伴。
lines.en: The line breaks up and I turn to find the others.

lines.zh: 走慢点，我这身板转不过来。
lines.en: Slow down; this body of mine can't turn quickly.

lines.zh: 扬起一路尘土，我不在意。
lines.en: I kick up a trail of dust and don't mind.

lines.zh: 蕨叶扫过肚子，痒得我甩尾。
lines.en: Ferns brush my belly and my tail flicks.

lines.zh: 冠里灌进风，呜呜地响。
lines.en: Wind fills my crest and it moans softly.

lines.zh: 我头顶的管子，一吹就响。
lines.en: The tubes on my head sound when I blow.

lines.zh: 我站着，慢慢把一丛草嚼完。
lines.en: I stand and slowly finish a clump of grass.

lines.zh: 头冠朝天，让风替它出声。
lines.en: Crest up to the sky, letting the wind speak for it.

lines.zh: 饱了，我眯起眼睛晒太阳。
lines.en: Full now; I squint into the sun.

lines.zh: 远处有动静，我先不动。
lines.en: Something moves far off; I hold still first.

lines.zh: 冠是空心的，吹起来像低音号。
lines.en: My crest is hollow; it blows like a low horn.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱了拱土，没什么。
lines.en: I nudge the dirt with my nose — nothing there.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的午后，长得很。
lines.en: A Cretaceous afternoon lasts a long time.

lines.zh: 我抬起前蹄，挠了挠脖子。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg to scratch my neck.

lines.zh: 同伴在不远处，我们都不说话。
lines.en: The herd is nearby; none of us speaks.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一张一合，闻着草味。
lines.en: My nostrils flare, tasting the smell of grass.

lines.zh: 这身皮厚，太阳烤不透。
lines.en: This hide is thick; the sun can't cook through it.

lines.zh: 我打了个长嗝，声音闷在冠里。
lines.en: I belch long and low, muffled inside my crest.

lines.zh: 风吹草低，露出一条小路。
lines.en: The wind bends the grass and shows a little path.

lines.zh: 先别动，等它们先动。
lines.en: Don't move yet — let them move first.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到后腿，歇一歇。
lines.en: I shift my weight to my hind legs and rest.

lines.zh: 一棵蕨被啃秃了，是我干的。
lines.en: That fern is stripped bare — my doing.

lines.zh: 你站得真直，两条腿不累吗？
lines.en: You stand so straight — don't two legs tire you?

lines.zh: 我抬起冠，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I raise my crest and look you up and down.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，能吃吗？
lines.en: That thing in your hand — is it food?

lines.zh: 你的气味留在草上，我记住了。
lines.en: Your scent lingers on the grass; I have memorized it.

lines.zh: 你闻起来不像草，也不像肉。
lines.en: You smell neither of grass nor of meat.

lines.zh: 我低低叫了一声，算是问好。
lines.en: I call low once, by way of hello.

lines.zh: 你要跟着走？那就跟着吧。
lines.en: Following us? Then follow.

lines.zh: 冠对着你，声音会传得很远。
lines.en: My crest faces you; sound will carry far.

lines.zh: 你太矮了，我要低下头看你。
lines.en: You're so short I have to lower my head to see you.

lines.zh: 别突然跑，我这群容易惊。
lines.en: Don't bolt suddenly; this herd startles easily.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脸，下次就不躲了。
lines.en: I know your face now; next time I won't shy.

lines.zh: 你在看我的冠？它只是骨头和空腔。
lines.en: Staring at my crest? It's only bone and hollow space.

lines.zh: 我疼得叫了一声，冠都在响。
lines.en: I cry out in pain and my crest rings.

lines.zh: 这一下打在腿上，我站不稳。
lines.en: That hit my leg; I can't stand steady.

lines.zh: 皮厚也挡不住这么打。
lines.en: Thick hide doesn't stop a blow like that.

lines.zh: 我往队伍那边退。
lines.en: I fall back toward the herd.

lines.zh: 别打了，我跑不快。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I'm not fast.

lines.zh: 身上一抽，脚步就乱了。
lines.en: A jolt runs through me and my steps scatter.

lines.zh: 冠里的空腔嗡嗡作响，是疼。
lines.en: The hollows of my crest hum with pain.

lines.zh: 叫声变调了，同伴会听出不对。
lines.en: My call cracks; the herd will hear something's wrong.

lines.zh: 草丛里没有遮挡，我只好转身。
lines.en: No cover in the grass, so I turn to face it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，护住肚子。
lines.en: I lower myself and guard my belly.

lines.zh: 叶子！我鼻子比眼睛先知道。
lines.en: Leaves! My nose knew before my eyes did.

lines.zh: 那丛蕨，我一口就能卷走。
lines.en: That fern — one sweep of my mouth takes it.

lines.zh: 我凑过去，先闻再吃。
lines.en: I lean in, sniff first, then eat.

lines.zh: 你举着草，我就跟你走两步。
lines.en: Hold out grass and I'll take two steps with you.

lines.zh: 别晃，晃得我脖子都跟着动。
lines.en: Stop waving it; my neck moves with it.

lines.zh: 植物就好，别的我都不碰。
lines.en: Plants only, nothing else passes my lips.

lines.zh: 这味儿甜，是嫩芽。
lines.en: Sweet smell — young shoots.

lines.zh: 脖子伸到最长，够到了。
lines.en: Neck stretched full length, and I reach it.

lines.zh: 吃相难看？我们这儿都这样。
lines.en: Bad table manners? We all eat like this here.

lines.zh: 再给我一丛，我就安静了。
lines.en: One more clump and I'll settle down.

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我就把脖子伸长。
lines.en: Raise the grass and I'll stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 这口吃完，我再决定跟不跟你。
lines.en: Let me finish this, then I'll decide about you.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还塞着，别急。
lines.en: My mouth's still full — wait.

lines.zh: 草叶的边是锯齿，我嚼得慢。
lines.en: The leaf edges are serrated; I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 甜味在舌尖散开，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Sweetness spreads over my tongue and my eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 就算只是草，也值得走这一趟。
lines.en: Even grass is worth the walk.

lines.zh: 我一屁股坐下去，差点压到你。
lines.en: I dropped onto my haunches and nearly crushed you.

lines.zh: 我头冠里的声音，能传很远。
lines.en: The sound in my crest carries far.

lines.zh: 我停下脚步，冠都晃了晃。
lines.en: I stop dead and my crest wobbles.

lines.zh: 对不起，我没看见脚边。
lines.en: Sorry — I didn't see you down there.

lines.zh: 这身肉撞起来是实心的。
lines.en: All this bulk hits like solid stone.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，你先走。
lines.en: I turn sideways; you go first.

lines.zh: 队伍太挤，我们互相顶着。
lines.en: The herd is packed tight; we push against each other.

lines.zh: 别推我尾巴，我会踢。
lines.en: Don't push my tail; I kick.

lines.zh: 撞完我甩甩头，没什么大事。
lines.en: After the knock I shake my head — nothing serious.

lines.zh: 这么大的路，你偏走我这条。
lines.en: So much open ground, and you walk into my lane.

lines.zh: 我把冠抬得最高，让它听清楚。
lines.en: I raise my crest highest so it hears me clearly.

lines.zh: 低音从冠里推出去，穿过整片平原。
lines.en: A low note pushes out through the plain.

lines.zh: 它回头了，我就再吹一次。
lines.en: It turned; I'll sound again.

lines.zh: 两头龙并排走，脚步对上了。
lines.en: Two of us walk abreast, steps falling together.

lines.zh: 我磨蹭着靠近，怕惊跑它。
lines.en: I edge closer, afraid to spook it.

lines.zh: 冠的形状不一样，我认得出它。
lines.en: Its crest is a different shape; I know it by that.

lines.zh: 我们在河湾边停下，谁也没走。
lines.en: We stop by the river bend and neither leaves.

lines.zh: 这一声，比刚才那声更软。
lines.en: This call is softer than the last.

lines.zh: 它把头顶过来，我接住了。
lines.en: It presses its head to mine, and I hold it.

lines.zh: 等季节过去，这声音就散了。
lines.en: When the season turns, this sound will fade.

lines.zh: 一小截树枝，我嚼了两下。
lines.en: A little twig — two chews and it's gone.

lines.zh: 我叼起蕨叶，慢慢咽下去。
lines.en: I pick up a fern frond and swallow it slowly.

lines.zh: 这东西硬，咬不动，扔了。
lines.en: Too hard to bite; I drop it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴唇卷起来，像卷草一样。
lines.en: I roll it up with my lips, the way I do grass.

lines.zh: 地上掉的野果，我闻了闻。
lines.en: A fallen berry; I sniff it.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在鼻尖上玩了一下。
lines.en: I balance it on my nose for a moment.

lines.zh: 石头？不是吃的，还你。
lines.en: A stone? Not food — back to you.

lines.zh: 这一把草，够我嚼一路。
lines.en: This mouthful of grass will last me the walk.

lines.zh: 我轻轻叼着，怕咬坏了。
lines.en: I hold it gently so I don't crush it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我先闻再接。
lines.en: Whatever's on the ground, I sniff before taking.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近队伍，我抬头了。
lines.en: Something nears the herd; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我压低冠，准备顶过去。
lines.en: I lower my crest, ready to butt.

lines.zh: 谁在那边？先看看再说。
lines.en: Who's over there? Let me look first.

lines.zh: 我的冠吹出低音，同伴都抬头。
lines.en: A low note from my crest lifts every head in the herd.

lines.zh: 我踩实了地，身子侧过去。
lines.en: I plant my feet and turn my flank to the threat.

lines.zh: 叫声传出去了，同伴会来。
lines.en: My call is out; the herd will come.

lines.zh: 我不主动打，但别逼我。
lines.en: I don't start fights, but don't push me.

lines.zh: 那人手里的东西在晃，我盯住了。
lines.en: The thing in that one's hand sways; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，又停住。
lines.en: I take half a step and stop.

lines.zh: 这么大的体型，撞一下可不轻。
lines.en: This much weight behind a shove is no small thing.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，不让你背后靠近。
lines.en: I circle you so you can't get behind me.

lines.zh: 头一直朝着你，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: My head stays on you; I don't blink.

lines.zh: 我压低冠，像要顶又不顶。
lines.en: I lower my crest as if to charge, and hold.

lines.zh: 冠里的低音越来越粗。
lines.en: The note in my crest grows coarser.

lines.zh: 我等着你先动。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 地被我踏出两个坑。
lines.en: My feet have worn two pits in the ground.

lines.zh: 同伴散开了，只剩我顶着。
lines.en: The herd has scattered; I'm the one holding.

lines.zh: 我鼻子喷气，声音很响。
lines.en: I snort through my nose, loud and sharp.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的脖子够得着。
lines.en: Not too close; my neck can reach.

lines.zh: 这么僵着，我腿都酸了。
lines.en: Held this long, my legs are going stiff.

lines.zh: 我一头顶过去，冠先撞上。
lines.en: I drive my head forward; the crest hits first.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，整个身子压上去。
lines.en: I kick off my hind legs and throw my weight in.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，尘土全起来了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and the dust rises.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，地面都震了。
lines.en: I stamp, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 撞开你，我才好带队伍走。
lines.en: Shoving you aside clears the way for the herd.

lines.zh: 我的头冠一吹，整群都听见。
lines.en: One call through my crest and the herd hears.

lines.zh: 我后腿蹬地，整副身子压来。
lines.en: I shove off my hind legs and throw my whole bulk forward.

lines.zh: 我甩头，冠划出一道弧。
lines.en: I swing my head and the crest carves an arc.

lines.zh: 顶完我就退，不想再打。
lines.en: After the butt I back off; I don't want more.

lines.zh: 身上的土都抖下来了。
lines.en: The dirt shakes right off my hide.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里站起来，草叶还挂着。
lines.en: I rise out of the grass with fronds still on me.

lines.zh: 平原尽头，一群影子慢慢显形。
lines.en: At the plain's edge, a herd of shadows takes shape.

lines.zh: 冠先探出，接着才是身子。
lines.en: My crest shows first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 这里的草，比记忆里矮。
lines.en: The grass here is shorter than I remember.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖皮，沙粒落了一地。
lines.en: I shake my hide and sand scatters.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，空气很干。
lines.en: First breath, and the air is dry.

lines.zh: 我环顾四周，找我们的老路。
lines.en: I look around for our old road.

lines.zh: 一声长鸣，同伴听见就会来。
lines.en: One long call, and the herd will come.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的太阳，怎么这么小。
lines.en: The Cretaceous sun seems so small here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站稳，四条腿都在抖。
lines.en: I steady myself, all four legs trembling.

lines.zh: 我先低头吃一口，确认是草地。
lines.en: I take one bite first, to be sure it's grassland.

lines.zh: 别围过来，我还没缓过神。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; I'm still collecting myself.

lines.zh: 火燎到冠上，疼得我直甩头。
lines.en: Flame catches my crest and I shake my head wildly.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，腿折了似的。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and my legs feel broken.

lines.zh: 河水没到脖子，我喘不上气。
lines.en: The river reaches my neck and I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀得四脚朝天。
lines.en: A blast flips me onto my back.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肋侧，走一步就疼。
lines.en: Something's stuck in my ribs; every step hurts.

lines.zh: 紫色的东西钻进皮里，又冷又麻。
lines.en: Something violet seeps into my hide, cold and numb.

lines.zh: 草都被吃光了，我肚子空得响。
lines.en: The grass is gone; my belly growls empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，四条腿都软了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and all four legs go weak.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，什么都没有了。
lines.en: The ground vanishes and there's nothing under me.
